mentions.name: Nvidia PhysX for GameMaker
mentions.description: A GameMaker extension that integrates the Nvidia PhysX physics engine, exposing PhysX functionality through an API for use in GameMaker game projects. A public alpha is launching in two weeks.
mentions.source_excerpt:
I added Nvidia PhysX to GameMaker.
https://youtu.be/CNy4D0Kfu34
I have a public alpha launching in two weeks, so this video is unlisted at the moment. Nervous but I'm pretty happy with the current API.
